description:
Because:
- Four files outside fxa-shared import ILogger from fxa-shared/log.
- The lib ILogger was not assignable to the fxa-shared ILogger because of `trace`.

This commit:
- Imports ILogger from @fxa/shared/log in pushbox, stripe-firestore and audit-tokens.
- Moves `trace` from the fxa-shared ILogger to the Logger interface in lib/logger.ts.
- Removes the unused `trace` line from three object literals that failed tsc.
- Removes the ./log and ./log/* exports from the fxa-shared package.json.
- Uses a relative log import in user-manager.ts.

Closes FXA-10663
